title: An Interpretable Chemoinformatics Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Learning Frameworks, Decoy Sensitivity, and Green Catalyst Prioritization: Software and Supporting Data
description: Published v0.3.0 software and data archive accompanying the manuscript and Supplementary Information by Gagan Sai Amith Pennada, VIT-AP University, India. Version-specific DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24032491. Project concept DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23383768. GitHub source repository: https://github.com/amith2427/Green-Catalyst-Screening. The archive contains the final main manuscript PDF, final Supplementary Information PDF, the 5,000-row Seed 42 synthetic dataset, the 20-seed metrics and TreeSHAP log for seeds 42–61, the supplementary positive-control and learning-curve log, the consolidated Python reproduction script, the 22-substrate library, dependency specifications, citation references, checksums, and traceability documentation. All reaction data and targets are synthetic. The Python source code is licensed under MIT; the synthetic datasets and written documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0. The archived metrics are traceable and consistency-checked, but an independent complete clean rerun has not yet succeeded.
references: Pennada, Gagan Sai Amith. (2026). An Interpretable Chemoinformatics Benchmark for Evaluating Machine Learning Frameworks, Decoy Sensitivity, and Green Catalyst Prioritization. Manuscript. School of Computer Science and Engineering, VIT-AP University, India.
